configurations.// next-dev-handoff: Handoff 22a-27a review server. Own dist dir: a dev server killed mid-compile leaves the previous one locked on Windows, and Next then hangs at Starting forever rather than reporting the lock, so it must not share one with a concurrent session. Runs the local node rather than the npm scripts npx -y node@20, which sat for five minutes without producing a dist dir or a log line.
configurations.name: next-dev-handoff

configurations.// next-dev-playwright: Playwright e2e server on the port playwright.config.ts expects (3101), aimed at the .env.test database by file NAME so no connection string lives in this file. Its OWN dist dir: the default `.next-playwright-<port>` had 22 files COMMITTED to git despite .gitignore listing `.next-playwright-*/` (ignore rules do not apply to already-tracked files), so git and Next wrote the same paths and the server died mid-run with `UNKNOWN: unknown error, open react-loadable-manifest.json` and 500'd every route. scripts/playwright-dev-server.cjs refuses to start against production and cleans its own dist dir; Playwright reuses this server rather than spawning a second. ADMIN_PASSWORD mirrors the throwaway value CI sets for the @admin specs.
configurations.name: next-dev-playwright
